findings.description: F002 calls the evidence a binding snapshot but omits base_sha, even though F001/F006 make the pinned base SHA the key proof that the worktree was created from the correct base.
findings.recommendation: Include base_sha, and preferably repo_root, in every lock/audit/close/dispatch binding snapshot test and evidence record.

findings.description: F003 does not pin behavior when the invoking directory is not inside any git worktree. For a bound plan, that context is still not the bound worktree and must refuse before side effects.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit bound-plan test for invocation outside a git checkout, requiring refusal unless override-with-reason is supplied.

findings.description: F004/F007 do not distinguish recorded branch from current branch or mark branch drift as broken, so the bound path could pass guards while close/dispatch mutates a detached or wrong branch.
findings.recommendation: Pin branch semantics: render actual branch, compare it to the recorded branch, and either mark mismatch as broken or refuse guarded mutations.

findings.description: F005 records owner_actor in the removal audit entry but not the actor performing the cleanup, which weakens the audit trail when someone other than the owner removes the worktree.
findings.recommendation: Record remover_actor using the same actor resolution rule, while preserving owner_actor from the binding for context.

findings.description: The no-DontPanic-merge non-goal is only asserted in prose with a dangling D005 reference, while no acceptance item pins the absence of plan merge or worktree merge CLI surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Add a CLI-surface scope-guard test proving no DontPanic merge command exists and no worktree command performs merge-to-main behavior.
